title: List each academic year, the term code, and the number of newly introduced
question: List each academic year, the term code, and the number of newly introduced subjects in this term. Display the academic year only if it differs from the previous entry. Include a grand total (the corresponding year field should be 'TOTAL') stating the total number of subjects across all academic years.

WITH term_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_CODE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
),
first_appearance AS (
  SELECT
    ts.TERM_CODE,
    ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ts.SUBJECT_ID,
    MIN(ts.TERM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY ts.SUBJECT_ID) AS first_term
  FROM term_subjects AS ts
),
new_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    SUBJECT_ID
  FROM first_appearance
  WHERE TERM_CODE = first_term
),
term_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS new_subject_count
  FROM new_subjects
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    TERM_CODE,
    new_subject_count,
    LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY TERM_CODE) AS prev_year

    '' AS TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS new_subject_count,
    1 AS sort_order
  FROM term_subjects

ORDER BY sort_order, TERM_CODE

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

(inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), TermInfo AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), DeptSubjects AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_PARAMETER, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TermInfo AS t ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(d.num_subjects) FROM WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS pts JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY pts.TERM_CODE, ays.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, max_enrolled_students FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

  FROM term_counts
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN prev_year IS NULL OR ACADEMIC_YEAR <> prev_year THEN ACADEMIC_YEAR ELSE '' END AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    TERM_CODE,
    new_subject_count,
    0 AS sort_order
  FROM with_lag
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    '' AS TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS new_subject_count,
    1 AS sort_order
  FROM term_subjects
)
SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, new_subject_count
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY sort_order, TERM_CODE
